# Legacy Sports G�� Copilot Instructions=�ܿ **NEVER commit to main** G�� create a worktree first: `twig worktree create LS-####/description`## Workflow1. Ticket: create if needed using the `jira_create_ticket` MCP tool (or `acli jira workitem create --summary "..." --project LS --type Task`) ? note `$key`2. **Jira "In Progress" immediately**: use the `jira_transition` MCP tool with status "In Progress" (or `acli jira workitem transition --key LS-#### --status "In Progress"`) � do this as soon as you begin working, before any other steps.3. **Dependency check**: inspect the Jira ticket for "blocked-by" linked issues. Query their status before proceeding: - **Blocker is not In Review or Done ? STOP.** Do not proceed with the ticket. Inform the user that the blocking ticket must reach at least "In Review" before work can begin. - **Blocker is In Review ? use its branch as the parent.** The worktree must branch from that ticket's branch, not from `main` (see `skills/worktree-workflow/SKILL.md` Step 1). - **Blocker is Done (or no blockers) ? base off `origin/main`.**4. Worktree: `twig worktree create $key/description` G�� `twig worktree list` (note path)5. Setup worktree: `make wt-setup WT=$wt` (or manually: `cd $wt` G�� `make install` G�� copy `.env` G�� junction `.twig`) 5b. **Agent multi-root access** (optional): `make sync-worktrees` G�� `code legacy-sports.code-workspace` G�� gives agents search access across all worktrees in one window.6. **G��n+� All remaining work happens at the worktree path (`$wt`), NOT `D:\code\legacy-sports`.** Every file edit, terminal command, and git operation must target `$wt`.7. Code: `make <target>` (e.g. `make test`, `make build`, `make typecheck`, `make lint-fix`). For project-specific targets: `pnpm exec nx run <project>:<target>`. Never use `pnpm run` directly.8. Commit: `git commit -m "type(scope): msg"` G�� `git push origin HEAD`9. Rebase onto parent: `git fetch origin ; twig rebase` � keeps branch current with its parent (main or a stacked branch) 9b. **Post-rebase stabilization (BEFORE push)**: `make install ; pnpm exec nx run db:print-schema ; pnpm exec nx affected -t codegen --base=origin/main` � main may have changed deps, schema, or formatting. **Do NOT push until `make pc` passes** (see `skills/rebase-conflicts/SKILL.md` Step 7).10. **Migrations (BEFORE make pc)**: run `pnpm run db:status` then `pnpm run db:up` from `lib/db-client` � **always do this even if you think no migrations were added.** Confirm `Applied N new migrations` or `No new migrations to apply`. (See `skills/db-migration-write/SKILL.md`)11. Validate: `make pc` � must pass before pushing or opening PR. If `nx format:write` rewrites any files, `make pc` **fails** with a list of the changed files; commit them and re-run `make pc`. 11b. **Push only after `make pc` passes**: `git push --force-with-lease origin HEAD` � pushing before validating is the #1 cause of post-rebase CI failures.12. **Ship (REQUIRED G�� do NOT stop before this step)**: `gh pr create --title "LS-#### type(scope): msg" --body-file .github/tmp-pr-body.md --base main` G�� `.\scripts\cleanup-pr-body.ps1` G�� Jira "In Review" (see `skills/create-pr/SKILL.md`)13. Cleanup: `twig worktree clean` G�� `git branch -d LS-####/description` G�� Jira "Done"## Rules- **Drive to PR**: your work is **NOT complete** until a PR is created and Jira is moved to "In Review". Passing `make pc` is a checkpoint, not the finish line. After validation passes, you **must** continue to: commit ? push ? `gh pr create` ? Jira "In Review". Stopping after code changes or after `make pc` without opening a PR is the single most common agent failure mode.- **Worktree-first**: always create a worktree for ticket work � never edit code in the main repo (`D:\code\legacy-sports`). After creating the worktree, all file edits and terminal commands must use the worktree path.- **Shared node_modules � do not mutate**: Worktrees share `node_modules` via Windows junctions to the main repo. **Never run `make clean`, `make install`, `make install-force`, or `pnpm install` in the main repo** (`D:\code\legacy-sports`) while worktrees are active � doing so destroys or mutates the shared `node_modules` and breaks every junctioned worktree mid-flight. Only run install/clean commands **inside your own worktree**, and only when it has independent (non-junctioned) `node_modules`.- **Never raw `pnpm install`**: always use `make install` (or `make install-force`) instead of running `pnpm install` directly. The Makefile targets acquire a file lock (`.pnpm-install.lock`) that prevents concurrent installs from corrupting the shared `node_modules`. `make wt-setup` also shares this lock.- **Make first**: prefer `make <target>` over raw `pnpm exec nx` � it sets `NODE_OPTIONS` for the Windows windowsHide patch and is cross-platform safe. For project-specific targets use `pnpm exec nx run <project>:<target>`. Never use `pnpm run` directly. See `skills/makefile/SKILL.md` for the full target list.- **PowerShell**: `;` to chain, `$env:` for vars- **No suppression**: fix root causes, no `@ts-ignore` / `eslint-disable` (see `skills/no-lint-disable/SKILL.md`)- **No console.\***: use `LOGGER` from `@legacy-sports/logging` instead of `console.log/warn/error/debug`. Exceptions: `lib/logging/` (the logger itself), `apps/cli/`, migration files, and build-time scripts (`codegen.ts`, Vite plugins).- **E2E tests are hermetic**: never use `route.continue()` in E2E tests — there is no backend in CI. Use `route.fulfill()` for unmatched operations (return a diagnostic error so missing mocks surface immediately). When changing login/landing page UI, update E2E selectors in the same PR (see `skills/e2e-testing/SKILL.md`).- **Jira � MCP tools first**: use the MCP Jira tools (`jira_view`, `jira_create_ticket`, `jira_transition`, `jira_check_blockers`, `jira_set_parent`) for **all** Jira operations. These are provided by the `legacy-sports-jira` MCP server (see `skills/mcp-jira/SKILL.md`). **Never** use `fetch_webpage`, raw HTTP requests, or web fetch to access Jira URLs directly. If MCP tools are unavailable, fall back to `acli` CLI commands � never to direct HTTP. Update Jira status at each workflow step.- **Resolve PR review threads**: when addressing PR review comments (from Copilot or any reviewer), **always resolve each thread** after pushing the fix. Use the GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation: `gh api graphql -f query='mutation($id:ID!){resolveReviewThread(input:{threadId:$id}){thread{isResolved}}}' -f id=$threadId`. Fetch thread IDs via GraphQL `reviewThreads` query, filtering for `isResolved: false`. Leaving threads unresolved after fixing them is incomplete work.## EnvironmentWindows PowerShell -+ Nx monorepo -+ pnpm 9.12.1 -+ Jira project LS -+ twig branches## Load When Needed| Task | File ||
